item.title: [HIGH] Peru prosecutors probe two Lima schoolboys accused of selling AI-made nudes of female classmates
item.description: Two secondary students, reportedly aged 13 and 14, allegedly took classmates' photos from social media, used an AI app to make nude images and sold them as packs for 15 to 30 soles. Chorrillos family prosecutors opened a child pornography investigation, the Women's Ministry demanded sanctions, and the school moved the two boys to virtual classes. Target: At least 12 to 15 girls aged 13 to 16 at a private school in Chorrillos, Lima. PE. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Peru's BCP denounces AI video impersonating Credicorp CEO Gianfranco Ferrari in scam
item.description: Banco de Credito del Peru said a social media video of Credicorp CEO Gianfranco Ferrari inviting the public into an investment programme was an AI simulation of his voice and appearance, and announced legal action. Target: Banco de Credito del Peru customers. PE. Verification: confirmed.
